title.hi: ठोस अपशिष्ट प्रबंधन: सिद्धांत एवं 3R ढांचा (Reduce, Reuse, Recycle)

definition.en: Solid Waste Management comprises the disciplined collection, segregation at source, transportation, recycling, resource recovery, and scientific disposal of municipal solid waste according to the waste hierarchy.

content.en: Solid Waste Management comprises the disciplined collection, segregation at source, transportation, recycling, resource recovery, and scientific disposal of municipal solid waste according to the waste hierarchy.
content.hi: Solid Waste Management comprises the disciplined collection, segregation at source, transportation, recycling, resource recovery, and scientific disposal of municipal solid waste according to the waste hierarchy.

content.en:
• Waste Hierarchy: Reduce → Reuse → Recycle → Recovery (Waste to Energy) → Disposal (Sanitary Landfilling as last resort).
• Daily waste generation in India is over 1.5 lakh metric tonnes; over 70% is collected and ~50% is treated.
• Landfills generate methane (CH4) through anaerobic decomposition, contributing to greenhouse warming and spontaneous fires.

question.en: Under the waste management hierarchy, which of the following represents the most preferred strategy?
question.hi: Under the waste management hierarchy, which of the following represents the most preferred strategy?

explanation.en: In the waste hierarchy, Prevention / Source Reduction is the most preferred tier, followed by Reuse, Recycling, Recovery, with Disposal (Landfilling) being the least preferred option.
